description:
It's Electric!!! Classic Electric Drive Version Compact Adult Folding Trike, with 20x1.75 wheels, Front Caliper Brake and SINGLE SPEED coaster brake. Pedal or Power. The choice is yours.

PEDAL or POWER OR BOTH!!! The Worksman Lightning Trike gives you the extra boost you need for greater mobility, activity and fun. Join thousands of riders of all ages who have discovered the freedom and liberty they enjoy on their Worksman Lightning Trike. The New and Improved Lightning Electric Trike Single speed, with the all new Worksman Electric kit Electric Drive system..includes reverse function. Cycling has never been this much fun or this convenient. This exciting tricycle is based upon our world famous Port-o-trike (with all the great features including folding frame capability for convenient storage and transport) which can be pedaled or ridden under power. The electric front hub motor is integrated into the 20" front wheel for smooth and efficient power. The Lightning Trike has a caliper brake and coaster (foot) brake, wide comfortable seat, large rear cargo basket, upright handlebars, and much more. To operate the electric system, there is a simple throttle on the handlebars. Simply turn the throttle to your desired speed and go! The Lightning trike comes complete with a 10AH 48V Lithium battery and charger. multi function Color Dashboard give you all the details you need...MPH, Battery Life, Odometer and so much more. Simply plug it into a standard wall outlet when not in use. Riding range of about 18 miles between charges. This tricycle is recommended for riders weighing less than 200 pounds and for heights of appx 4'8" to 6'0". As with all electric assisted cycles, it is the customer's responsibility to determine if this cycle is in compliance with any local ordinances. We recommend this cycle only for responsible adult riders. Minimal assembly required. Worksman Cycles has partnered with two overseas suppliers to create the ultimate electric front hub drive system. The Worksman Lightning E Kit. Featuring a comprehensive color LED dashboard, 48V Lithium Ion Battery with integrated LED Taillight, easy to use throttle and reverse function and powerful drive system. Includes easy to use charger.
